run_EmpConfidenceInt_get_eci: run EmpConfidenceInt to get empirical prediction intervals for a time series forecasting model
run_EmpConfidenceInt_run_cv: run cross validation on a forecasting model to calculate standard error per horizon
run_EmpConfidenceInt_get_lr: run linear regression to fit standard error against forecast horizon
plot_EmpConfidenceInt_diagnose: plot a diagnostic scatter plot of empirical standard error versus forecast horizon
plot_EmpConfidenceInt_plot: plot time series forecast with empirical confidence interval bands overlaid on historical data
